AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.
AC5-ROOT-01.barrier: Damage prevention creates no damage root.

AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.bodySourceEnding: If the primary finite creature source ends first, that body ends under its source, then the AC5 exile immediately closes. BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining extant independently legal secondary body/corpse/object once; ended/absent bodies remain absent. AC5-PLANAR-META-01.classification: NEW spell/campaign metadata for Planar Protection, Planar Binding and Alignment Portal only; not a master cosmology
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.planeKey: An opaque stable ID for an actual plane record already established by campaign/source authority. The key carries no automatic alignment, deity, native-species, soul-destination, Wheel, dominion or tributary meaning.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.siteId: A stable known physical destination site on one planeKey with actual location/footprint/support data.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.travelProvenance: On a successful cross-plane body transition using a reviewed source, the Director may record currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = the actual origin planeKey and the transport event ID. A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only

Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only

Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.

No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only

Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. No unprinted gem, soul, ingredient, costly reagent, CR assignment or imported monster statblock is added. All four explicit profile objects supplied below remain distinct and unrated.

Select the actual corpse, exact profile and any own authority slot to release before payment. Require a genuinely usable connected torso/head and enough surviving actual matter for that body, perceived within60feet/LoE at its current physical anchor. Unlike Danse, no arbitrary24-hour age cap applies; real present decay, missing parts and harvested quantities decide actual usability. Copies, fragments, vanished summons, already consumed/raised bodies and resource-prohibited artificial corpses cannot fund another physical allocation. Known failure is rejected before commitment; a hidden later failure spends the real spell costs without selecting another body. Retain all body/gear/anatomy/history and actual documented needs. New animation HP does not repair limbs, remove Wounds, add proficiencies or duplicate armor.

NEW permanent physical conversion is completed once. The consumed body persists independently of its original caster and its original corpse never becomes fresh fuel again. This is a mechanical body record, not a soul claim or forced cosmological resurrection. Its base HP is initialized once with only genuinely qualifying creation modifiers. Active source-owner/controller changes use actual MAXIMUM_HP rules, not new HP resets. NEW separate ongoing rank-six authority relation: the caster controls at most two such creations across all four alternatives. One actual owner command/offense per numbered round still applies across all assets, and no voluntarily acting creation appears in its creation round. Dispelling or suppressing the authority does not undo permanent flesh, destroy the old body, refill HP or create a new corpse. Suppressed/released bodies have their actual independent agency, not automatic creator loyalty or compulsory hostility. Permanent control after release is not silently retained through old orders. A later Create Undead cannot rebind an extant living animation as a corpse. Command Undeath requires a genuine documented CR2 profile and cannot be used on these unrated designs by convenience. Actual separately valid control is evaluated on its own terms.

Explicit consequence chosen under Q15A: repeating real13-RP-or-actually-modified casts with different eligible corpses and real releases can accumulate more than two permanent independent bodies over time. Real independent needs, decisions, location and opportunities are content/state prerequisites; no video-game performance cap is smuggled into the authored rule. No granted no-breath/food/water/sleep immunity follows from Undead: retain actual recorded requirements and bind missing body/needs facts before claiming a long-term environmental or work fixture complete.

All six saves are original creating class-ownerPB total; other untrained checks use the profile ability modifier. No unprinted resistances, condition immunity, fortitude, hunger-based resource recovery, spells or class RP are created. Compatible real armor can replace base AC only under actual fitting/proficiency penalties. Intrinsic appearance/wrapping is not salvage. Physical limb attacks remain ordinary physical native attacks; NEW the Ghoul's slowing rider, Ghast's directed grave exhalation and Wight's necrotic projection are source-specific magical nonspell components, not new spell casts. Actual antimagic can suppress those expressions without undoing the permanent body; physical ordinary actions and underlying agency remain subject to their real prerequisites. Damage type alone supplies no general magical classification outside these named profiles.

A positive post-defense/pre-temp-HP hit packet prompts CON vs original creating class current DC; failure gives Speed-10 until the target's next future regular END excluding one underway, or6elapsedseconds outside initiative. Strongest-adverse-Speed arbitration; no paralysis, hard Action denial or additive slow stacking.

One melee5ft2d6slashing original-creator attack OR one directed15-foot grave-exhalation cone from its actual head/oral outlet, all creatures with LoE including allies, CON vs original creator current DC for2d6poison, half on success. These are alternative uses of the same offensive Action. No persistent gas, disease, Poisoned, collectible toxin or recharge pool.

Wight: baseHP45 AC15; STR12 DEX16 CON12 INT8 WIS12 CHA8; walk30 with supports. One ranged60ft attack using original creating class current spell attack for2d8necrotic, no ability add, from actual Wight sight/LoE. Actual close-quarters/ranged conditions apply. This native magical nonspell attack is not a spell cast, physical arrow, life drain, maxHP reduction or create-undead ability.

Mummy: baseHP70 AC16; STR18 DEX6 CON16 INT6 WIS12 CHA8; walk20 with supports. One limb-dependent melee5ft original-creator attack for2d10bludgeoning without add. completeHistoricalRecordUnchanged.procedure:

NEW choose exactly one of those four profiles and one distinct perceived Small or Medium Humanoid corpse within range/line of effect. The four explicitly NEW complete profiles are printed immediately below and stored as structured records, rather than substituting a generic zombie. Base HP/AC, six ability scores, permitted movement and Actions are separately supplied for each. Saving throws use original creator's current PB; other checks use its printed ability modifier without proficiency. Actual source-qualified maximum-HP modifiers apply. Attack criticals follow ordinary rules. Genuine usable worn armor may replace base AC under its own rules without creating a second formula or proficiency. Real carried/worn gear retains its prior damage, charges and actual inventory; equipping a new weapon does not silently add an unprinted attack profile.

NEW conversion itself is instantaneous and permanent: later dispelling/antimagic does not recreate the former corpse, undo physical damage or restore the former person. Creator command authority is a separate ongoing rank-six control relation until dispelled/released, with at most two active Create Undead control relations per creator across all four profiles. Before casting at full capacity, declare which existing relation a successfully created new body will release. Failed creation leaves that old relation intact. Creation never destroys a released body to make room. Newborn authority is part of this explicitly created animation chassis, not a hostile control attempt against a living target; it grants no control over a surviving original person. A later hostile control spell still needs its own actual hard-control admission.

While that authority operates, use the shared created-companion command, profile and original-owner statistics. NEW no voluntary movement, Dodge, command, attack or support during its creation numbered round; outside initiative its first potential opportunity is the next ordinary six-second cycle. Passive defenses and conditions still operate. No automatic Wizard standard-minion slot, Corpse Harvest, Auto-Raise, Ghoul Lash, elite identity, class repertoire or monster harvest recipe is gained. These two spell-control slots are separate from genuine other class slots, but all owned bodies retain the one shared command and offensive allowance. Healing can restore its legal current HP without repairing anatomy, curing Wounds, refreshing body provenance or creating resources.

This is an HP-only animated creature: at zero HP it is destroyed without a new dying/death-save/Wound track and leaves its same consumed physical remains and real surviving gear. Actual existing injuries and anatomy restrictions remain through creation and healing. Dispel of creator authority, voluntary release or an admitted slot replacement leaves the living animation with its real profile and present HP. Suppression releases only that relation's control while suppressed; it does not erase the permanent body. A released/suppressed animation has ordinary Director-controlled agency based on actual events, no guaranteed loyalty or automatic hostility, and only its finite profile/basic actions. It regains an independent regular opportunity under the no-duplicate-cycle transition, not an immediate free turn; a suppressed relation resumes with all spent budgets/history retained. Original creation source statistics remain the stated original-owner formulas even after release, not a free new owner's level. Caster incapacity/death alone ends neither body nor relation; unavailable phases give no invented commands. Actual rest may meet genuine needs but supplies no unprinted class/resource recovery. No repeated creator binding ritual is granted by recasting on the now-living animation. Its CR remains unrated: none of these new profiles qualifies for Command Undeath's exact CR 2 predicate without a separate actual CR decision.

Keep original corpse, conversion, animation, current controller, injuries, material loss and inventory events in one physical-provenance ledger. The original body is not simultaneously available for resurrection, harvesting or another animation. A genuine resurrection source must meet its own consumed-body reconstruction requirements; this spell supplies none and decides no soul ownership or destination. The four profiles' varied movement and attack roles, permanent released bodies, two-control cap and unrated CR are consequential new designs for actual GPT review.
workedCases: IN6-11-A: A legal corpse becomes one Ghast, not several generic zombies. Its base HP is 50 before actual qualified modifiers, its real missing hand remains missing, and its real armor is neither repaired nor duplicated. It cannot act in the creation numbered round. On a later lawful command it chooses its 15-foot exhalation instead of its melee attack, spending the same shared offensive allowance; the cone can affect allies.

The Ghoul remains a real animation at its existing HP and gains no immediate bonus turn or refreshed corpse status. The Mummy uses base HP 70/AC 16 and its distinct strike, subject to real modifiers. CL10-CAST-01.title: Source identity, access, costs and real clocks
CL10-CAST-01.classification: INHERITED interfaces with explicitly identified spell-local completions
CL10-CAST-01.scope: These ten ordinary spells; no source/catalog rewrite
CL10-CAST-01.completeText:
Keep each complete current source/access object and every original Core/catalog entry unchanged. The catalog's actual class-school placement, rank and minimum class level must be paired with a real learned/prepared repertoire. A source-only access row does not supply the rest of an unsupplied class engine. No union of another class's schools is allowed. Universal Create Homunculus remains Universal; Necromancy remains Necromancy. No named material, blood, corpse, gem or monetary component is inferred from a title. Golem and Danse retain V/S/M-F evidence; the inherited focus alternative is usable without inventing consumed materials.

All ten have an Action casting time and printed 60-foot range. Preserve that range as evidence even where Soulburn's proposed self-only recovery narrows its operation. Base RP is 7 at rank 4, 10 at rank 5 and 13 at rank 6. Apply only actual accepted price rules and acquired class exceptions. Quote and pay before ordinary counter/interrupt resolution; a future recovered pool cannot fund that quotation. Source-specific HP costs are real normal-HP costs, not damage, healing, temporary HP or a shareable packet. They cannot lower the payer below 1 HP. Countered or paid hidden-ineligible outcomes do not refund HP/RP or restore displaced concentration.

Use the accepted spell-commitment, Dissonance/Refrain and Ready rules, not a generic new sequence. The acquired Wizard matrix exception can change base Dissonance; it does not erase Refrain. Idle turns do not reset either. A readied spell pays/prepares and begins held concentration at preparation; its legal target/area is selected and checked at release. The particular effect's lifetime begins only at successful release/establishment. A separately source-authorized nonspell Action repair/readied technique has its own payment at actual execution, not an invented spell cast.

NEW spell-local durations retained for authoring: Corpse Golem, Death Knight and Soul Wraith require concentration and end 60 actual seconds after establishment. Flood/Danse animation bodies end 3,600 actual seconds after their successful formation and require no concentration. Their printed Instantaneous metadata describes establishment, not a rewrite of the original. Create Undead's physical conversion is permanent; its separate rank-six authority relation and Command Undeath last until their real removal. Homunculus's created body/control is persistent with the distinct endings stated below. Soulburn and Grave Gift resolve instantaneous components and create no upkeep duration. An outside-mode six-second cycle is a clock mapping, never an extra action. Absolute deadlines, true regular owner markers, body-source expiry and already-spent command resources never reset on suppression, healing, release, renaming or mode changes.

CL10-COMMAND-01.title: Created companions, ownership and stat provenance
CL10-COMMAND-01.classification: INHERITED command/stat rules; NEW named asset caps and creation-round policies
CL10-COMMAND-01.scope: Golem, Knight, Wraith, Flood/Danse zombies, Create Undead and Homunculus only
CL10-COMMAND-01.completeText:
Keep original creator, current controller, body identity and source application as distinct records. Original creator-derived spell attacks, DCs and saves use the actual original creating class record; a temporary controller does not lend a better casting modifier. A profile that says PB as the total save bonus does not also add its ability modifier. Profile attacks add no ability damage unless that particular attack prints it. Critical hits double eligible attack dice, not flat modifiers or a later independent saving-throw aura.

The acquired Wizard Conjuration creation bonus is tested against an actual creature created by that Wizard's spell, not against the creating spell's school label alone. Snapshot its +Wizard-level maximum HP at genuine qualifying creation. The separately acquired Flesh Ascendant bonus is the current eligible controlling Wizard's +2 per Wizard level where its actual controlled-Undead predicate passes. Preserve the accepted exception that permits those two distinct bonuses together and the single strongest eligible application of each named source; no alias duplication. Later maximum-HP changes use the accepted clamp/capacity rules and do not themselves heal. If the source-owner later dies, its extant class/stat record does not become zero or a different controller's statistics.

While creator-controlled, each capable named asset resolves only in the actual attached phase after the whole owner's regular turn. A paid Bonus Action on that regular turn directs at most one eligible asset. It uses the accepted owner-wide one-command allowance and, for offense, the one-offensive-asset allowance for that numbered round across pets, minions, devices and these spells. Do not grant an independent Reaction, an extra owner turn, a second command during an extra Action or a second offensive asset because spell/class asset caps differ. The commanded asset must satisfy its own position, perception, path and resource prerequisites when it resolves. An issued command is not refunded or replayed if that phase lacks a legal action. Lack of a valid command permits only the source's actual defensive movement/Dodge, not an attack, skilled task or resource use.

NEW source limits: one Corpse Golem, one Death Knight, one Soul Wraith and one Homunculus per original caster; one Flood body; one Danse cohort containing at most five; two Create Undead authority slots. These are separate from Wizard's three standard-minion slots, Ranger Beast, Mage elite slots, Mirror assets and the existing Expedition roster. They do not multiply the shared command/offense allowances. A successful replacement ends/replaces only that spell's indicated source/body/control record. A known cap replacement must be declared before commitment; a failed new establishment never selects a substitute, but starting new concentration has already ended an incompatible prior concentration.

Golem, Knight, Wraith and Homunculus may use a genuine still-available creation-turn Bonus Action command and subsequent real attached phase; creation itself supplies no attack/task. NEW Flood, Danse and Create Undead forbid all voluntary acts in the numbered round of creation, including a bonus Dodge; outside initiative their first possible phase is the next genuine six-second cycle. The actual source lifespan starts at formation even while this prohibition applies. Creator incapacity alone does not retroactively cancel an already valid nonconcentration order; actual concentration ending or source/body loss does. An absent original owner supplies no fictitious attached phase. Command Undeath and release of a permanent Create Undead body use CL10-ORDER-01, not an invented owner-turn refresh.

CL10-BODY-01.title: Bodies, geometry, stock and incomplete facts
CL10-BODY-01.classification: INHERITED body/gear rules; explicit scope boundaries
CL10-BODY-01.scope: Only the named authored bodies; not a world physiology or environment engine
CL10-BODY-01.completeText:
Use Tiny 2.5-by-2.5-foot, Small/Medium 5-by-5-foot and Large 10-by-10-foot occupied horizontal spaces under the accepted body rule. A source body's measured height, current orientation, actual missing parts, body mass and supports are separate facts. No named class or ordinary Small/Medium Beast gets a two-foot combat body from [1,1,1]. A new scenario must print its actual body extents; numeric damage-only examples do not prove range, cone, collision, reach or close-quarters eligibility.

A created body's initial space must already fit, be unoccupied, be perceived/targetable within the source's real range and have the source-required support before casting. No future growth or creation expands the world to legalize a target. A corpse conversion occurs at its same actual physical anchor using current matter, not a free relocation to a convenient empty square. Voluntary size changes obey actual preflight. Mandatory source ending, death, reversion, body removal and release of melded cargo always happen; no body-reservation ward or whole external-event veto is created. Where this proposal explicitly calls canonical normalization, use same anchor, legal squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent space in the same unobstructed region, minimum displacement/greatest overlap/fixed neutral board tie, with no farther search or wall/occupant passage. Normalization spends no movement and creates no opportunity/charge/movement rider. Banishment's separately named conflict semantics are not imported.

All carried/worn items are real separate IDs. Apply actual physical-capacity AND Load limits, hand/slot/fit restrictions and Burdened penalties. A listed local smaller cargo limit adds a restriction; it does not cancel weight or Load. Genuine body parcels count as bodies under their source, never bundled equipment. Created intrinsic swords/wrappings/appearance have no independent harvestable stock. On actual body ending, real gear uses current-position legal item placement, nearest legal adjacent item placement or pending-placement state. No item jumps to a distant historical last-open square, and disappearance never recreates old cargo, repairs its condition or refills fuel.

Corpse-derived animations retain one consumed physical allocation, original body history, missing limbs, harvested parts, real gear and documented physiological/terrain requirements. Their fresh listed base HP is a new animation HP pool, not limb repair, Wound treatment, resurrection or corpse replenishment. No-breath/no-food/no-water/no-sleep, immunity, natural origin and soul status cannot be inferred from the Undead/Construct label. A permanent-body work/exposure scenario must bind the actual retained needs and applicable recovery rules; an unavailable need/profile fact remains an explicit input prerequisite, not an immunity. This conference gives no global corpse-decay or living-physiology engine. The newly generated finite manifestations and Homunculus likewise gain only their stated traits; source-dependent environmental use needs the actual required trait record.

Command Undeath's required CR is an authoritative mechanical profile field, not an appearance check or a derived result from these new HP values. All four Create Undead alternatives remain unrated. The complete frozen bestiary is a source-only record collection; no exact operative CR2 Undead is supplied. A positive Command fixture therefore remains conditional until a complete individually authorized eligible profile is bound.

CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.title: Damage roots, disabled bodies and valid healing
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.classification: INHERITED root/life order plus NEW limited animation lifecycle binding
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.scope: The seven created/animated-body spells here; no universal Undead healing grant
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.completeText:
A creature attack creates its damage root at the actual accepted damage checkpoint, with that acting companion as dealer and the original creator retained separately as stat/source owner. Creator Veil does not automatically make a Golem/Knight/Wraith/zombie attack Null. Flood's ordinary spell packet has its caster as dealer. Separate attack events create separate roots; child packets inherit their parent flag; sharing preserves flags and never double-counts the parent and terminal branches. Apply the actual real damage, prevention, temporary HP, Wound/death and actual immediate-response sequence. Do not decide actual death just from reaching zero.

Qualifying Null damage uses the accepted ordered protection, including damage-caused Instant Death/Wound/Maiming/fatal-Wound exclusions and retained prior zero-state histories. It is not an HP-cost prevention, independent expiry immunity, resurrection or concentration immunity. Golem, Knight, Wraith and Homunculus bind their existing finite-created/Construct recipient branches: a qualifying Null packet taking the surviving body to zero, or hitting the same already-disabled body, records/preserves NullDisabled0 rather than ordinary damage-caused disappearance. This adds no living-ally target predicate, Wounds, death saves, Stable roll or rest regeneration to these HP-only profiles. Their own concentration, expiry, dismissal, replacement and suppression endings still happen.

NEW named extension: Flood zombies, Danse zombies and the four Create Undead bodies use the same finite or persistent consumed-animation principle for qualifying Null damage: preserve the same body/allocation, authority, HP0, gear and clocks in NullDisabled0; no fresh corpse destruction or resource trigger. This specifically binds these new profiles and does not relabel them as Wizard standard minions. Further qualifying Null damage neither destroys nor refreshes them. Independent authority/source ending, genuine non-Null damage causing the profile's ordinary zero/destroyed branch, or another actually applicable real ending remains effective. A living target of Flood instead uses its own real living/death-save/Beast lifecycle; Null preventing its death prevents Flood's zombie claim.

Legal positive restoration to the same extant disabled body clears only that zero-HP disabled state. It never refills a command, lifespan, ability, limb or inventory. Homunculus's explicit maintenance and Wraith's own self-lifetap are named permissions. Any other proposed repair/heal must supply an actual eligible target source. Cleric Healing Rite requires a living ally, and the scoped AC4/AC5/AC6 living-ally extensions do not include these new bodies. This conference does not extend that predicate. A source with its own creature-only healing permission can be evaluated on its actual terms; Undead/Construct alone supplies neither immunity nor universal eligibility.

CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.title: Distinct suppression and terminal identity
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.classification: NEW source-local lifecycle choices constrained by accepted antimagic and life rules
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.scope: Only these named applications under the actual suppressing source; not a global field-size rule
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.completeText:
Do not unify the bodies merely because they are summons. A full operational body-expression suppression ends Corpse Golem, Soul Wraith and Homunculus immediately with current-position real cargo settlement and no stored return. For Golem/Wraith this also ends that now-empty creating application; it does not resume when the field ends. A narrower suppressed attack/rider suppresses only its own expression unless the actual field also suppresses the body sustaining expression.

Death Knight instead temporarily has no expressed body. Record its actual current pose when suppression starts, same identity/HP/NullDisabled state/current maximum/source owner/spent allowances and absolute deadline. Real external gear drops there under existing item placement, and intrinsic shadow equipment produces nothing. The absent body provides no occupancy, cover, support, attack or sensory presence. When all applicable suppressors end while the source remains live, attempt to re-express that same body at the saved pose using the local canonical fitting procedure. An occupied saved pose is not a protected berth. If no local placement is legal, expression remains pending within the original source lifetime; no extra duration is granted. Re-expression does not automatically reclaim dropped gear. A suppressed field can still contain the pending pose; it cannot resume merely by asking for an outside square. If source/clock ends first, nothing is re-created. A legal unsupported re-expression starts the actual Falling rules.

Flood and Danse keep their actual consumed physical bodies and real carried gear in place while their sustaining animation is suppressed. Suppressed animation supplies no voluntary movement, offense or command execution; gravity, ordinary collision/support, externally inflicted effects and absolute clocks remain real. Their eventual hour/zero/dispel/dismissal ending leaves the same consumed remains, not a fresh corpse. Create Undead is different again: permanent physical conversion is not undone by dispelling/suppressing its separate authority relation. Suppression of authority restores the body's underlying real independent agency; it does not grant an extra opportunity or free loyalty. Any independently magical native action/rider remains subject to the actual field on its own terms. Command Undeath similarly suppresses control, not an existing body's physical existence.

NEW limited geometric completion: when accepted Lesser Antimagic intersects any part of the actual expressed body of Golem, Knight, Wraith, Homunculus, Flood zombie or Danse zombie, treat that named body's sustaining expression as fully suppressed for the lifecycle above. This extends no other spell or field and grants no immunity to merely partial-body intersections. For a temporarily absent Knight test the saved expression volume. Local suppression of Create Undead/Command Undeath authority is tested at the actual bound body's volume; it changes authority, not permanent flesh. These specific choices are proposed here, not inherited globally from the two AC5 or three AC6 families. Use their actual source family exception and spell-disruption rules without editing accepted AC5/AC6.

A suppressed queued command is spent/lost at its one genuine opportunity, not banked for resumption. Source expiry, real body death/removal and mandatory form endings are never vetoed by suppression. Direct removal uses the actual class/ordinary Dispel rank/cost/check and immutable operation rules. A Wizard rank-three class Dispel is not an ordinary rank-three Dispel by name, and Greater Dispel does not replay a previously suppressed removal merely because a suppressing field was ended in the same captured operation set.

CL10-ORDER-01.title: Command Undeath and released permanent bodies
CL10-ORDER-01.classification: NEW Command-Undeath/Create-Undead-only schedule and agency completion
CL10-ORDER-01.scope: No extension of DE4 domination to other sources
CL10-ORDER-01.completeText:
Choose Q14 option B: an already independent bound creature keeps its actual pre-binding initiative position and regular opportunities. Do not migrate it to the binder's attached phase. An existing companion keeps its actual original owner's attached phase and all source-owner stats/slots. Binding, suppression, release, death of a controller and return from suppression do not create an immediate turn, refresh a used Action/Reaction, replay START/END hooks or reset a recharge. The exact actual owner or independent schedule must be bound before a current worked fixture can be claimed complete.

While Command Undeath is operative, its non-Charmed permanent restriction permits only defensive movement/Dodge without a valid command. On the binder's actual regular turn, a Bonus Action through the spell's 60-foot same-plane perceived/LoE command channel can queue one bounded order for one target's next actual future behavior opportunity. A turn already underway is not a future opportunity. The order expires at that single opportunity whether executed, suppressed, invalid, impossible or budget-starved, or at the binder's next regular START or issuance+6 actual seconds, whichever occurs first. The six-second cap is a NEW Command-Undeath-only absolute order expiry, not a new lifetime for the permanent relation. Only one pending order per binder-target exists; it cannot be banked through absence or suppression. Reaching a deadline that is also a possible execution point expires it first under the actual ordered phases. A successfully heard order does not create an ongoing remote channel: later plane separation can prevent new issue, not supply new knowledge or alter the already fixed instruction.

The issuing Bonus Action consumes the actual owner-wide command allowance of its issuance round. At execution the binder's owner-wide offensive allowance for that execution round must also be unused and is consumed once; a command that crosses a round boundary neither duplicates an offensive allowance nor refunds its prior command. For a source-owned companion, both binder's and original owner's structural allowance for that body/phase must be satisfied. Reuse an existing reservation only for the same body, same phase and same offensive opportunity; do not charge an unwilling owner a new Bonus Action or reserve another companion's attack. The absent original owner supplies no invented attached action phase. Resolve genuinely competing source-qualified directives under actual applicable ordering; this proposal does not grant authority to override another named source's explicit priority.

A valid instruction can use the body's actual movement and one ordinary Action, including a native inherent Multiattack only when the bound profile really has it. It does not force optional finite-resource powers, spellcasting, expended charges/recharges, new Bonus Actions/Reactions, secrets, prohibited oaths, item surrender or a suicide operation. Mandatory ordinary ammunition/material expenditure of an otherwise legal ordinary attack still needs the actual item; an instruction creates none. Type/obedience is not a source of private knowledge. Range and LoE for an executed attack are measured from the actual acting body, not the binder. No order changes donor or soul identity.

Suppressed Command control restores ordinary underlying agency at the same real scheduled opportunity; no instruction is performed while the control is suppressed and none replays later. When control resumes, restore the still-live relation and future defensive-only restriction without repeating its already-admitted hard-control save. Actual target death ends that relation; caster death alone does not, but a dead/absent/incapacitated binder cannot issue legal orders. The caster can release its own relation on its actual regular turn without an Action. It grants no automatic loyalty, hostility, faction membership or property ownership afterward.

For Create Undead only, losing/suppressing/replacing creator authority leaves the permanent actual body alive in its current animation state. On first independent agency, preserve that numbered round's spent opportunity and creation-round prohibition. Do not give an immediate action: place its next independent regular slot immediately after its former creator slot at that slot's next scheduled occurrence, using stable body-ID order for a group. If an old slot cannot recur because the owner has left the encounter, retain its captured virtual slot solely as a scheduling marker and assign an independent slot at the next actual encounter scheduling boundary; no retroactive turn is invented. Restoring authority retires that independent slot only prospectively into the creator's next genuinely available attached phase; at most one voluntary opportunity per round survives the transition. This is a NEW limited transition rule for these permanently created profiles, not a global controller/initiative rewrite.

Released bodies need actual NPC behavior/needs/context records before a autonomous-work/combat sequence can be claimed complete. Release is not a direction to attack, obey forever, donate HP, take a crew job or harvest another corpse. Two authority slots are not a world population cap. Repeated genuinely paid Create Undead casts with different eligible real corpses may accumulate independent bodies over time; no automatic service, material reward or free roster space follows.

Outside initiative, a released permanent body uses independent successive six-second opportunities beginning no earlier than its next unspent former cycle boundary; re-entering initiative maps that pending opportunity without replay or refresh. This defines timing only. It supplies no unreviewed NPC goal, ability, reaction budget, physiology or work permission.

Grave Gift remains Necromancy rank5, Action, base10RP, V/S/F,60feet and Instantaneous. Preserve sacrificing halfHP to restore an ally fully from Dying. NEW target is one other actually willing living ally at0HP, currently Dying or Stable, perceived within60feet and LoE. A positive-HP ally, self, a corpse/actually dead body, a vanished summon or an unqualified nonliving animation is not the target. A mechanically living-ally extension from a different named spell is not imported.

Before commitment require the donor to have at least2 current normalHP. The paid half is floor(current normalHP/2), with minimum1, calculated once at commitment; at least1normalHP must remain. Pay that amount and the actual final spell RP price at commitment. This is an actual HP cost, not a damage or shared/healing-transfer packet. No temporaryHP, resistance, armor, prevention, damage-sharing redirect, Debt, Death Ward or floor supplies a free cost. A donor at1HP cannot commit. An actual later death, new target death or hidden loss of eligibility can defeat resolution after costs; nothing rewinds the paid amount or makes an actually dead recipient living.

NEW the restorative component is direct state recovery, not ordinary healing: if the same eligible recipient can gain HP at resolution, set its current normalHP to its then-current effective maximum. Preserve every Wound, Injury, Critical state, anatomical loss, disease, resource, gear record and independent condition. Clear the Dying/Stable counters and recovery deadline as required by leaving0HP and remove only zero-HP-caused Unconscious/Incapacitated. Prone remains until actually ended. The ordinary-healing Critical ceiling and ordinary-healing bonuses/reductions/copies/rolls/excess-healing conversions do not transform this direct assignment. Three Wounds therefore remain Critical even at full current effective maximum; this does not cure the Wounds or change global healing ceilings.

An actual broad 'cannot regain HP' effect, such as current Chill Touch's hit rider, blocks that assignment. NEW independently, successful eligible Grave Gift resolution stabilizes a still-Dying recipient: clear its death-save counters, leaveHP0, establish exactly one actual d4-hour Stable-recovery deadline under Core. If it was already Stable, preserve its old deadline and do not roll again. This is a Grave-Gift-only stabilization component, not a general outcome of blocked heals. Dead/ineligible or wholly countered/suppressed spells receive neither component. Being Stable0 still has the actual zero-state conditions; this is not consciousness or an immediate recovery.

Actual positive HP gained can satisfy a different existing feature only when that feature's exact event/recipient predicates truly include this kind of gain. There is no ordinary-healing event, healing dice, overheal award or automatic resource reward. The ordinary cause and private numeric recovery information stay under accepted disclosure policy; a d4 Stable clock supplies no new Fate presentation grant. The donor receives no part of the benefit.

CL10-CAST-01.title: Source identity, access, costs and real clocks
CL10-CAST-01.classification: INHERITED interfaces with explicitly identified spell-local completions
CL10-CAST-01.scope: These ten ordinary spells; no source/catalog rewrite
CL10-CAST-01.completeText:
Keep each complete current source/access object and every original Core/catalog entry unchanged. The catalog's actual class-school placement, rank and minimum class level must be paired with a real learned/prepared repertoire. A source-only access row does not supply the rest of an unsupplied class engine. No union of another class's schools is allowed. Universal Create Homunculus remains Universal; Necromancy remains Necromancy. No named material, blood, corpse, gem or monetary component is inferred from a title. Golem and Danse retain V/S/M-F evidence; the inherited focus alternative is usable without inventing consumed materials.

All ten have an Action casting time and printed 60-foot range. Preserve that range as evidence even where Soulburn's proposed self-only recovery narrows its operation. Base RP is 7 at rank 4, 10 at rank 5 and 13 at rank 6. Apply only actual accepted price rules and acquired class exceptions. Quote and pay before ordinary counter/interrupt resolution; a future recovered pool cannot fund that quotation. Source-specific HP costs are real normal-HP costs, not damage, healing, temporary HP or a shareable packet. They cannot lower the payer below 1 HP. Countered or paid hidden-ineligible outcomes do not refund HP/RP or restore displaced concentration.

Use the accepted spell-commitment, Dissonance/Refrain and Ready rules, not a generic new sequence. The acquired Wizard matrix exception can change base Dissonance; it does not erase Refrain. Idle turns do not reset either. A readied spell pays/prepares and begins held concentration at preparation; its legal target/area is selected and checked at release. The particular effect's lifetime begins only at successful release/establishment. A separately source-authorized nonspell Action repair/readied technique has its own payment at actual execution, not an invented spell cast.

NEW spell-local durations retained for authoring: Corpse Golem, Death Knight and Soul Wraith require concentration and end 60 actual seconds after establishment. Flood/Danse animation bodies end 3,600 actual seconds after their successful formation and require no concentration. Their printed Instantaneous metadata describes establishment, not a rewrite of the original. Create Undead's physical conversion is permanent; its separate rank-six authority relation and Command Undeath last until their real removal. Homunculus's created body/control is persistent with the distinct endings stated below. Soulburn and Grave Gift resolve instantaneous components and create no upkeep duration. An outside-mode six-second cycle is a clock mapping, never an extra action. Absolute deadlines, true regular owner markers, body-source expiry and already-spent command resources never reset on suppression, healing, release, renaming or mode changes.

CL10-COMMAND-01.title: Created companions, ownership and stat provenance
CL10-COMMAND-01.classification: INHERITED command/stat rules; NEW named asset caps and creation-round policies
CL10-COMMAND-01.scope: Golem, Knight, Wraith, Flood/Danse zombies, Create Undead and Homunculus only
CL10-COMMAND-01.completeText:
Keep original creator, current controller, body identity and source application as distinct records. Original creator-derived spell attacks, DCs and saves use the actual original creating class record; a temporary controller does not lend a better casting modifier. A profile that says PB as the total save bonus does not also add its ability modifier. Profile attacks add no ability damage unless that particular attack prints it. Critical hits double eligible attack dice, not flat modifiers or a later independent saving-throw aura.

The acquired Wizard Conjuration creation bonus is tested against an actual creature created by that Wizard's spell, not against the creating spell's school label alone. Snapshot its +Wizard-level maximum HP at genuine qualifying creation. The separately acquired Flesh Ascendant bonus is the current eligible controlling Wizard's +2 per Wizard level where its actual controlled-Undead predicate passes. Preserve the accepted exception that permits those two distinct bonuses together and the single strongest eligible application of each named source; no alias duplication. Later maximum-HP changes use the accepted clamp/capacity rules and do not themselves heal. If the source-owner later dies, its extant class/stat record does not become zero or a different controller's statistics.

While creator-controlled, each capable named asset resolves only in the actual attached phase after the whole owner's regular turn. A paid Bonus Action on that regular turn directs at most one eligible asset. It uses the accepted owner-wide one-command allowance and, for offense, the one-offensive-asset allowance for that numbered round across pets, minions, devices and these spells. Do not grant an independent Reaction, an extra owner turn, a second command during an extra Action or a second offensive asset because spell/class asset caps differ. The commanded asset must satisfy its own position, perception, path and resource prerequisites when it resolves. An issued command is not refunded or replayed if that phase lacks a legal action. Lack of a valid command permits only the source's actual defensive movement/Dodge, not an attack, skilled task or resource use.

NEW source limits: one Corpse Golem, one Death Knight, one Soul Wraith and one Homunculus per original caster; one Flood body; one Danse cohort containing at most five; two Create Undead authority slots. These are separate from Wizard's three standard-minion slots, Ranger Beast, Mage elite slots, Mirror assets and the existing Expedition roster. They do not multiply the shared command/offense allowances. A successful replacement ends/replaces only that spell's indicated source/body/control record. A known cap replacement must be declared before commitment; a failed new establishment never selects a substitute, but starting new concentration has already ended an incompatible prior concentration.

Golem, Knight, Wraith and Homunculus may use a genuine still-available creation-turn Bonus Action command and subsequent real attached phase; creation itself supplies no attack/task. NEW Flood, Danse and Create Undead forbid all voluntary acts in the numbered round of creation, including a bonus Dodge; outside initiative their first possible phase is the next genuine six-second cycle. The actual source lifespan starts at formation even while this prohibition applies. Creator incapacity alone does not retroactively cancel an already valid nonconcentration order; actual concentration ending or source/body loss does. An absent original owner supplies no fictitious attached phase. Command Undeath and release of a permanent Create Undead body use CL10-ORDER-01, not an invented owner-turn refresh.

CL10-BODY-01.title: Bodies, geometry, stock and incomplete facts
CL10-BODY-01.classification: INHERITED body/gear rules; explicit scope boundaries
CL10-BODY-01.scope: Only the named authored bodies; not a world physiology or environment engine
CL10-BODY-01.completeText:
Use Tiny 2.5-by-2.5-foot, Small/Medium 5-by-5-foot and Large 10-by-10-foot occupied horizontal spaces under the accepted body rule. A source body's measured height, current orientation, actual missing parts, body mass and supports are separate facts. No named class or ordinary Small/Medium Beast gets a two-foot combat body from [1,1,1]. A new scenario must print its actual body extents; numeric damage-only examples do not prove range, cone, collision, reach or close-quarters eligibility.

A created body's initial space must already fit, be unoccupied, be perceived/targetable within the source's real range and have the source-required support before casting. No future growth or creation expands the world to legalize a target. A corpse conversion occurs at its same actual physical anchor using current matter, not a free relocation to a convenient empty square. Voluntary size changes obey actual preflight. Mandatory source ending, death, reversion, body removal and release of melded cargo always happen; no body-reservation ward or whole external-event veto is created. Where this proposal explicitly calls canonical normalization, use same anchor, legal squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent space in the same unobstructed region, minimum displacement/greatest overlap/fixed neutral board tie, with no farther search or wall/occupant passage. Normalization spends no movement and creates no opportunity/charge/movement rider. Banishment's separately named conflict semantics are not imported.

All carried/worn items are real separate IDs. Apply actual physical-capacity AND Load limits, hand/slot/fit restrictions and Burdened penalties. A listed local smaller cargo limit adds a restriction; it does not cancel weight or Load. Genuine body parcels count as bodies under their source, never bundled equipment. Created intrinsic swords/wrappings/appearance have no independent harvestable stock. On actual body ending, real gear uses current-position legal item placement, nearest legal adjacent item placement or pending-placement state. No item jumps to a distant historical last-open square, and disappearance never recreates old cargo, repairs its condition or refills fuel.

Corpse-derived animations retain one consumed physical allocation, original body history, missing limbs, harvested parts, real gear and documented physiological/terrain requirements. Their fresh listed base HP is a new animation HP pool, not limb repair, Wound treatment, resurrection or corpse replenishment. No-breath/no-food/no-water/no-sleep, immunity, natural origin and soul status cannot be inferred from the Undead/Construct label. A permanent-body work/exposure scenario must bind the actual retained needs and applicable recovery rules; an unavailable need/profile fact remains an explicit input prerequisite, not an immunity. This conference gives no global corpse-decay or living-physiology engine. The newly generated finite manifestations and Homunculus likewise gain only their stated traits; source-dependent environmental use needs the actual required trait record.

Command Undeath's required CR is an authoritative mechanical profile field, not an appearance check or a derived result from these new HP values. All four Create Undead alternatives remain unrated. The complete frozen bestiary is a source-only record collection; no exact operative CR2 Undead is supplied. A positive Command fixture therefore remains conditional until a complete individually authorized eligible profile is bound.

CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.title: Damage roots, disabled bodies and valid healing
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.classification: INHERITED root/life order plus NEW limited animation lifecycle binding
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.scope: The seven created/animated-body spells here; no universal Undead healing grant
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.completeText:
A creature attack creates its damage root at the actual accepted damage checkpoint, with that acting companion as dealer and the original creator retained separately as stat/source owner. Creator Veil does not automatically make a Golem/Knight/Wraith/zombie attack Null. Flood's ordinary spell packet has its caster as dealer. Separate attack events create separate roots; child packets inherit their parent flag; sharing preserves flags and never double-counts the parent and terminal branches. Apply the actual real damage, prevention, temporary HP, Wound/death and actual immediate-response sequence. Do not decide actual death just from reaching zero.

Qualifying Null damage uses the accepted ordered protection, including damage-caused Instant Death/Wound/Maiming/fatal-Wound exclusions and retained prior zero-state histories. It is not an HP-cost prevention, independent expiry immunity, resurrection or concentration immunity. Golem, Knight, Wraith and Homunculus bind their existing finite-created/Construct recipient branches: a qualifying Null packet taking the surviving body to zero, or hitting the same already-disabled body, records/preserves NullDisabled0 rather than ordinary damage-caused disappearance. This adds no living-ally target predicate, Wounds, death saves, Stable roll or rest regeneration to these HP-only profiles. Their own concentration, expiry, dismissal, replacement and suppression endings still happen.

NEW named extension: Flood zombies, Danse zombies and the four Create Undead bodies use the same finite or persistent consumed-animation principle for qualifying Null damage: preserve the same body/allocation, authority, HP0, gear and clocks in NullDisabled0; no fresh corpse destruction or resource trigger. This specifically binds these new profiles and does not relabel them as Wizard standard minions. Further qualifying Null damage neither destroys nor refreshes them. Independent authority/source ending, genuine non-Null damage causing the profile's ordinary zero/destroyed branch, or another actually applicable real ending remains effective. A living target of Flood instead uses its own real living/death-save/Beast lifecycle; Null preventing its death prevents Flood's zombie claim.

Legal positive restoration to the same extant disabled body clears only that zero-HP disabled state. It never refills a command, lifespan, ability, limb or inventory. Homunculus's explicit maintenance and Wraith's own self-lifetap are named permissions. Any other proposed repair/heal must supply an actual eligible target source. Cleric Healing Rite requires a living ally, and the scoped AC4/AC5/AC6 living-ally extensions do not include these new bodies. This conference does not extend that predicate. A source with its own creature-only healing permission can be evaluated on its actual terms; Undead/Construct alone supplies neither immunity nor universal eligibility.

CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.title: Distinct suppression and terminal identity
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.classification: NEW source-local lifecycle choices constrained by accepted antimagic and life rules
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.scope: Only these named applications under the actual suppressing source; not a global field-size rule
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.completeText:
Do not unify the bodies merely because they are summons. A full operational body-expression suppression ends Corpse Golem, Soul Wraith and Homunculus immediately with current-position real cargo settlement and no stored return. For Golem/Wraith this also ends that now-empty creating application; it does not resume when the field ends. A narrower suppressed attack/rider suppresses only its own expression unless the actual field also suppresses the body sustaining expression.

Death Knight instead temporarily has no expressed body. Record its actual current pose when suppression starts, same identity/HP/NullDisabled state/current maximum/source owner/spent allowances and absolute deadline. Real external gear drops there under existing item placement, and intrinsic shadow equipment produces nothing. The absent body provides no occupancy, cover, support, attack or sensory presence. When all applicable suppressors end while the source remains live, attempt to re-express that same body at the saved pose using the local canonical fitting procedure. An occupied saved pose is not a protected berth. If no local placement is legal, expression remains pending within the original source lifetime; no extra duration is granted. These specific choices are proposed here, not inherited globally from the two AC5 or three AC6 families. Use their actual source family exception and spell-disruption rules without editing accepted AC5/AC6.

A suppressed queued command is spent/lost at its one genuine opportunity, not banked for resumption. Source expiry, real body death/removal and mandatory form endings are never vetoed by suppression. Direct removal uses the actual class/ordinary Dispel rank/cost/check and immutable operation rules. A Wizard rank-three class Dispel is not an ordinary rank-three Dispel by name, and Greater Dispel does not replay a previously suppressed removal merely because a suppressing field was ended in the same captured operation set.
