CL10-ORDER-01.title: Command Undeath and released permanent bodies
CL10-ORDER-01.classification: NEW Command-Undeath/Create-Undead-only schedule and agency completion
CL10-ORDER-01.scope: No extension of DE4 domination to other sources
CL10-ORDER-01.completeText:
Choose Q14 option B: an already independent bound creature keeps its actual pre-binding initiative position and regular opportunities. Do not migrate it to the binder's attached phase. An existing companion keeps its actual original owner's attached phase and all source-owner stats/slots. Binding, suppression, release, death of a controller and return from suppression do not create an immediate turn, refresh a used Action/Reaction, replay START/END hooks or reset a recharge. The exact actual owner or independent schedule must be bound before a current worked fixture can be claimed complete.

While Command Undeath is operative, its non-Charmed permanent restriction permits only defensive movement/Dodge without a valid command. On the binder's actual regular turn, a Bonus Action through the spell's 60-foot same-plane perceived/LoE command channel can queue one bounded order for one target's next actual future behavior opportunity. A turn already underway is not a future opportunity. The order expires at that single opportunity whether executed, suppressed, invalid, impossible or budget-starved, or at the binder's next regular START or issuance+6 actual seconds, whichever occurs first. The six-second cap is a NEW Command-Undeath-only absolute order expiry, not a new lifetime for the permanent relation. Only one pending order per binder-target exists; it cannot be banked through absence or suppression. Reaching a deadline that is also a possible execution point expires it first under the actual ordered phases. A successfully heard order does not create an ongoing remote channel: later plane separation can prevent new issue, not supply new knowledge or alter the already fixed instruction.

The issuing Bonus Action consumes the actual owner-wide command allowance of its issuance round. At execution the binder's owner-wide offensive allowance for that execution round must also be unused and is consumed once; a command that crosses a round boundary neither duplicates an offensive allowance nor refunds its prior command. For a source-owned companion, both binder's and original owner's structural allowance for that body/phase must be satisfied. Reuse an existing reservation only for the same body, same phase and same offensive opportunity; do not charge an unwilling owner a new Bonus Action or reserve another companion's attack. The absent original owner supplies no invented attached action phase. Resolve genuinely competing source-qualified directives under actual applicable ordering; this proposal does not grant authority to override another named source's explicit priority.

A valid instruction can use the body's actual movement and one ordinary Action, including a native inherent Multiattack only when the bound profile really has it. It does not force optional finite-resource powers, spellcasting, expended charges/recharges, new Bonus Actions/Reactions, secrets, prohibited oaths, item surrender or a suicide operation. Mandatory ordinary ammunition/material expenditure of an otherwise legal ordinary attack still needs the actual item; an instruction creates none. Type/obedience is not a source of private knowledge. Range and LoE for an executed attack are measured from the actual acting body, not the binder. No order changes donor or soul identity.

Suppressed Command control restores ordinary underlying agency at the same real scheduled opportunity; no instruction is performed while the control is suppressed and none replays later. When control resumes, restore the still-live relation and future defensive-only restriction without repeating its already-admitted hard-control save. Actual target death ends that relation; caster death alone does not, but a dead/absent/incapacitated binder cannot issue legal orders. The caster can release its own relation on its actual regular turn without an Action. It grants no automatic loyalty, hostility, faction membership or property ownership afterward.

For Create Undead only, losing/suppressing/replacing creator authority leaves the permanent actual body alive in its current animation state. On first independent agency, preserve that numbered round's spent opportunity and creation-round prohibition. Do not give an immediate action: place its next independent regular slot immediately after its former creator slot at that slot's next scheduled occurrence, using stable body-ID order for a group. If an old slot cannot recur because the owner has left the encounter, retain its captured virtual slot solely as a scheduling marker and assign an independent slot at the next actual encounter scheduling boundary; no retroactive turn is invented. Restoring authority retires that independent slot only prospectively into the creator's next genuinely available attached phase; at most one voluntary opportunity per round survives the transition. This is a NEW limited transition rule for these permanently created profiles, not a global controller/initiative rewrite.

Released bodies need actual NPC behavior/needs/context records before a autonomous-work/combat sequence can be claimed complete. Release is not a direction to attack, obey forever, donate HP, take a crew job or harvest another corpse. Two authority slots are not a world population cap. Repeated genuinely paid Create Undead casts with different eligible real corpses may accumulate independent bodies over time; no automatic service, material reward or free roster space follows.

Outside initiative, a released permanent body uses independent successive six-second opportunities beginning no earlier than its next unspent former cycle boundary; re-entering initiative maps that pending opportunity without replay or refresh. This defines timing only. It supplies no unreviewed NPC goal, ability, reaction budget, physiology or work permission.

procedure.temporalDeclaration: NEW EM150-INTERVAL. At direct commitment, or Ready preparation, declare one known event descriptor (maximum60 ordinary whitespace-delimited words, no encoded payload) and one fixed absolute nonempty continuous interval [a,b), duration at most300seconds. Caster must actually know enough to identify the event and time, never its hidden contents. At that declaration b must be no later than the current instant and no earlier than current instant−3600. Record immutable descriptor/bounds before private results. The interval must describe one continuous firsthand event segment, not an arbitrary list/concatenation of days. An overlong, future or knowingly stale declaration is rejected unpaid. No sliding selector or choosing a new event after a result. At effect resolution revalidate the same fixed endpoint b in [t−3600,t]; if it aged out after legal preparation/commitment, the memory component fails paid, with no automatic trim or substitute. This one-hour endpoint convention permits the start of a five-minute segment to precede the hour boundary by at most five minutes; it does not mean every affected instant must be inside the last hour. Half-open endpoints mean experiences at b itself are excluded. Recalled older events remain older. For a still-valid declaration remove only actual firsthand portions matching that event inside [a,b); no experience or uncertain identity gives no invented loss. An unknown result is private. Missing event evidence holds a positive case; it is not a source of truth for a new event.
procedure.admission: NEW one initial WIS save gates both memory and identity-shaken. Success: neither. On failure, independently admit the completed memory loss and the soft mental-attention rider under their actual defenses. Temporal/experience failure or a memory-only defense does not prevent the otherwise eligible identity rider; a rider-only defense does not prevent memory. A known impossible cast declaration still fails common preflight. Fully broad mental protection prevents both before any guard. Neither component is whole-Action control; no shared hard allowance is spent.
procedure.identityShaken: NEW EM150-ENTITLEMENT. On eligible failure create one soft disadvantage entitlement for the target's next WIS ability/skill check that actually begins while this entitlement is operative and before application+60seconds. It is not a saving-throw penalty, ability-score change, forced check, loss of Action/turn or changed identity/belief. Snapshot the entitlement when that check begins and consume it once, including when advantage cancels disadvantage or the check later has no useful result; resolving/canceling/replacing that roll cannot refund it. Automatic success/no check supplies no event. A check beginning at the exact deadline sees expiry first. Suppression postpones no clock and grants no penalty to checks begun while suppressed; such checks do not consume the inactive entitlement. procedure.native: KEEP Wizard15 Enchantment, Action/120feet/V,S,F/rank8/base21RP, control up to3 creatures of actual CR10 or less, WIS each turn, concentration up to1minute.
procedure.targetsAndSaves: NEW MD150-ADMISSION. Snapshot one to three distinct actually perceived creature identities within range/LoE at manifestation; no duplicate body/alias, target swap or future entrant. Each requires an actual source-defined CR≤10. Class level, HP, tier, size, companion rank and similar spell names are not a CR conversion. A known CR>10 cannot be selected; private ineligibility can defeat a paid otherwise legal selection without replacing it. If the record lacks an authoritative CR/type/body roster, keep the entire positive case held. Supplied bestiary CR2/3/5 rows can be exact conditional data vectors but are not operationally reviewed creatures. Initial WIS separately per eligible target; success gives no control, failure checks actual mental/control immunity and source-character hard guard. A genuinely established hard component spends that guard once. Repeat WIS at each regular target END, including the current turn's END when application happened midturn; success ends only this target's matching application. No extra-turn save. Base maximum is application+60seconds; an actual Enchantment-specialized Wizard's printed-duration extension may give a failed-save target+6seconds, preserving every save and caster concentration. That per-target66second maximum creates no additional effect for targets that saved.
procedure.orders: NEW MD150-ORDER, extending only the reviewed bounded Dominate Person interface to this identity. At each admitted target's FUTURE regular START, after all mandatory processing, a conscious unsuppressed controller on the same actual plane may issue at most ONE opportunity order to that target without spending a new Action/BA. The source gives no advance queue: before the checkpoint the controller can plan privately but no binding pending order exists. At the checkpoint snapshot exact legal instruction, target, controller, application, timestamp and known information; consume or reject it in that same opportunity. A turn already underway receives no late command and may reach its escape END before any controlled action. Owner-attached targets instead use the beginning of their real source-authorized original-owner regular attached phase, with the same one-opportunity rule. No order is issued outside a real permitted checkpoint. Conscious same-plane mental delivery needs no hearing/shared language/maintained120foot tether, gives no senses, location, thoughts or return channel, and fails if actual outgoing communication is blocked. Each of up to3 targets has its own instruction; no extra turn or shared extra budget is granted. The instantaneous delivery/attempt is serialized before later relocation; if an actual interruption makes an instruction unexecutable, it expires at that opportunity. Failed new issuance replaces no previously established controller.
procedure.budgetsAndExpiry: NEW an order can direct only available ordinary movement, the target's one ordinary Action and ordinary free interaction in that opportunity. Apply earliest valid instruction timestamp, then application order/stable source ID for simultaneous instructions, across the exact accepted compelled-budget interface. A losing instruction receives no second budget or fallback and cannot erase an earlier mandate. Bound ordinary Attack Actions retain their real native attack count; no invented attack profile. Do not compel Bonus Actions, Reactions, extra Actions, spells/RP, recharge abilities, charges, optional finite consumables, special expendable ammunition, permanent property surrender, protected secrets, belief, knowing oath violation, direct self-harm or a knowingly suicidal route. Only normal required ordinary ammunition can be paid as part of an otherwise legal ordinary attack. Use the safest reasonable executable interpretation from the target's actual knowledge; no magical routefinding or hidden fact readout. Unknown safety/profile holds the case. Invalid, impossible, suppressed, canceled, budget-starved or priority-losing instruction expires immediately after this opportunity, executed or not. It cannot bank, replay, become a standing order, retry on an extra turn, or convert to another action. For no valid order the target retains ordinary agency under its other actual conditions; there is no new mandatory Dodge except an actual companion chassis's own default.
procedure.companionsAndChanges: NEW MD150-COMPANION. Keep original owner, original source body/profile, real phase, one-companion allowance and shared offense cap. A valid pending original-owner BA command reservation may be redirected only for this same companion in this same phase, never another companion's or already spent allowance. A dominator cannot manufacture an unwilling owner's BA, transfer a chassis, grant a new companion slot, steal its resources or create an independent turn. Without real lawful phase no command/action executes: only END-only six-second repeat-save fallback/expiry. Preserve original marker and map next unresolved save on transition without replay. If required CR or actual owner/command reservation is missing, the entire positive companion case is held, even when other rules are fully authored. Changing controller invalidates old pending/in-flight instruction records; the new controller waits for its own next permitted checkpoint, with no refreshed budgets.
procedure.replacementAndEnding: NEW only one Mass Dominate controller/application controls a given target at a time. A genuinely admitted later application replaces the old for that target only; a saved, immune or guard-blocked attempt does not replace it. Other control identities are not deleted: exact instruction priority and shared remaining budgets govern. Same caster's NEW concentration commitment nevertheless ends its own incompatible old concentration before saves, including all old Mass Dominate targets, even when the replacement later fails. Ending one target by save/removal/terminal identity end releases only that target; end caster concentration or original maximum to release every remaining matching application. Damage alone has no new release save; loss of range or plane ends no established control by itself, but can stop future mental order issuance. Suppression preserves hard history, concentration and deadline, gives ordinary agency where otherwise lawful, and loses the missed order opportunity. Resume only future still-valid opportunities, never reapply an initially prevented component or delete a later application with an older expiry.
